source: hand-written for the companion-lanes proof (task 3): seven lines, six emotions, three gestures; p/b/m plosives and round vowels in every line

c1.line: Good morning. I am here, and your day is already open in front of me.

c2.line: Done. Your dentist moved to Thursday at ten, and I booked a reminder the morning before.

c3.line: Just one: a ten minute call with Bob from the product team. Plenty of room to breathe.

c4.line: Coffee is on the list, marked urgent. I would not want you to meet a Monday without it.

c5.line: Hmm. That is the meeting where they approve your new monitor. Are you sure about that?

c6.line: Two percent. Please plug it in now. Your boarding pass for the evening flight is on that phone.

c7.line: My pleasure. Good luck with the dentist, and maybe go home before nine for once.
